properties.title: Remodeled beachside home between the river and the ocean
properties.description: Sought-after 3 bed / 2 bath with a large primary suite and en-suite bath, set between the Intracoastal Waterway (Halifax River) and the ocean. Remodeled kitchen and upgraded baths make this a rare gem. Fully enclosed back porch gives much-needed open space for flexible use. Out back there is a paver patio and a fully fenced yard.

properties.title: Top-floor ocean view condo, fully renovated
properties.description: Your dream coastal retreat! This fully renovated 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo offers breathtaking ocean views and effortless beachside living from the TOP FLOOR of the building. Thoughtfully designed with a modern, open-concept layout, the kitchen is the heart of the home — sleek finishes, updated cabinetry and new appliances. New AC. Both bathrooms renovated with a fresh, spa-like feel. Offered fully furnished with all NEW stylish furnishings — truly move-in ready.

properties.title: Lakefront living in gated Plantation Bay
properties.description: Welcome to luxury living in the prestigious gated community of Plantation Bay! This beautifully updated 3 bedroom, 2 bath home offers cathedral-style ceilings, lakefront views from your own backyard, and an updated kitchen with stunning quartz countertops. The primary suite is a true retreat complete with a spa-inspired bathroom featuring a luxurious rain shower. New ceiling fans throughout and the garage is equipped with an EV charger.

properties.title: Five-bedroom coastal comfort in Sea Colony
properties.description: An exceptional five-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath home in the sought-after oceanfront gated community of Sea Colony. First-floor primary suite, true interior laundry, and a private heated and screened pool. Cement board siding and hurricane-rated windows (2023), new kitchen cabinets and appliances (2023), updated AC (2023), whole-house water filtration (2024), and a new roof (2022). Residents enjoy a 24/7 guarded entrance, oceanfront clubhouse, heated pool and spa, and private beach access.

properties.title: Ocean Shore Blvd beachfront condo
properties.description: Wake up to the Atlantic. Bright beachfront condo on Ocean Shore Boulevard with sweeping views, an updated kitchen, and a private balcony. Professionally managed by Culver Realty & Property Management — responsive maintenance, careful tenant screening, and easy online payments.

properties.title: Beachside pool home on Alamanda
properties.description: Charming beachside home on a quiet street east of A1A. Private pool, fenced yard, and a short stroll to the sand. Hands-on management and transparent owner reporting make this a tenant favorite.
